info.desc: "The New Abnormal" is the sixth studio album by American rock band The Strokes. It was released on April 10, 2020, through Cult and RCA Records. It comes nearly seven years after March 2013’s Comedown Machine, although the band had reunited briefly to release a three-track EP titled "Future Present Past" in June 2016. The album title "The New Abnormal" is a reference to the present age of environmental disaster. “There were these huge fires in Los Angeles,” Julian about their time recording. “A lot of houses burned down but Shangri-La survived, by some miracle. That’s where the name of .

podcast.body: The sixth Strokes record was released on April 10, 2020, amidst the COVID-19 pandemic, a timing that made its title particularly fitting. Produced by Rick Rubin in California and Hawaii, this change in producer and venue was exactly what the band needed. The album garnered great reviews and earned a Grammy Award for Best Rock Album. "This record was made with producer Rick Rubin in both California and Hawaii. And the change of producer and venue was exactly what the band needed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
